# runzero_user_invite (Resource)

Invites a user to RunZero via email. This is a create-only resource that sends an invitation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) The email address of the user to invite.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the user to invite.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the user to invite.

### Optional

- `client_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user should be a client administrator.
- `message` (String) Custom message body for the invite email. Write-only; not returned by the API.
- `org_default_role` (String) The default organization role for the user.
- `org_roles` (Map of String) Map of organization UUIDs to role names.
- `subject` (String) Custom subject line for the invite email. Write-only; not returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) The client UUID.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the invited user.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean) Whether MFA is enabled for the user.
- `name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `sso_only` (Boolean) Whether the user can only authenticate via SSO.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the user was last updated.
